ee_t3_osorio.name: EE-T3 Osório
ee_t3_osorio.authority: A fictional development (concept facet): the owner asked on 2026-10-30 for "a super modernized hypotehtical version a tier 9 and a tier 10" and Main ruled the same day (DECISIONS): EE-T3 Osório, tier IX, continuing Engesa's numbering as the Challenger 1's fictional FV4030/5 and /6 continue Vickers'. No such vehicle was built; the base is the surviving P.2, whose photographs these are, under a bolted nose module on the glacis, composite modules on the front three skirt panels, wedge modules on the cheeks and side armour boxes, a stabilised panoramic sight, the ARES-type remote 12.7 mm station, two 200 L fuel drums across the stern (the owner, 2026-10-31) and a 120 mm L/55.
ee_t3_osorio.envelopeBasis: Width, length and tallest are the as-built envelope of the shared Osório build (profiles/osorio.ts, mark t3): the P.2's 7.13 m hull and 2.37 m roof, the kit's widths over the composite skirt modules (3.43 m), the gun forward (11.274 m including the two fuel drums across the stern), the tallest the turret's whips (Box3 of the build at both qualities).
